source_text: Ὃν τρόπον δὲ καὶ ἀνεθήκαμεν ἑαυτοὺς τῷ θεῷ καινοποιηθέντες διὰ τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ἐξηγησόμεθα, ὅπως μὴ τοῦτο παραλιπόντες δόξωμεν πονηρεύειν τι ἐν τῇ ἐξηγήσει. Ὅσοι ἂν πεισθῶσι καὶ πιστεύωσιν ἀληθῆ ταῦτα τὰ ὑφ᾿ ἡμῶν διδασκόμενα καὶ λεγόμενα εἶναι, καὶ βιοῦν οὕτως δύνασθαι ὑπισχνῶνται, εὔχεσθαί τε καὶ αἰτεῖν νηστεύοντες παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ τῶν προημαρτημένων ἄφεσιν διδάσκονται, ἡμῶν συνευχομένων καὶ συννηστευόντων αὐτοῖς. Ἔπειτα ἄγονται ὑφ᾿ ἡμῶν, ἔνθα ὕδωρ ἐστί, καὶ τρόπον ἀναγεννήσεως, ὃν καὶ ἡμεῖς αὐτοὶ ἀνεγεννήθημεν, ἀναγεννῶνται· ἐπ᾿ ὀνόματος γὰρ τοῦ πατρὸς τῶν ὅλων καὶ δεσπότου θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ πνεῦματος ἁγίου τὸ ἐν τῷ ὕδατι τότε λουτρὸν ποιοῦνται. Καὶ γὰρ ὁ Χριστὸς εἶπεν· Ἂν μὴ ἀναγεννηθῆτε, οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν.“ Ὅτι δὲ καὶ ἀδύνατον εἰς τὰς μήτρας τῶν τεκουσῶν τοὺς ἅπαξ γεννωμένους ἐμβῆναι, φανερὸν πᾶσίν ἐστι. Καὶ διὰ Ἡσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου, ὡς προεγράψαμεν, εἴρηται, τίνα τρόπον φεύξονται τὰς ἁμαρτίας οἱ ἁμαρτήσαντες καὶ μετανοοῦντες. Ἐλέχθη δὲ οὕτως· Λούσασθε, καθαροὶ γένεσθε, ἀφέλετε τὰς πονηρίας ἀπὸ τῶν ψυχῶν ὑμῶν, μάθετε καλὸν ποιεῖν, κρίνατε ὀρφανῷ καὶ δικαιώσατε χήραν, καὶ δεῦτε καὶ διαλεχθῶμεν, λέγει κύριος· καὶ ἐὰν ὦσιν αἱ ἁμαρτίαι ὑμῶν ὡς φοινικοῦν, ὡσεὶ ἔριον λευκανῶ, καὶ ἐὰν ὦσιν ὡς κόκκινον, ὡς χιόνα λευκανῶ. Ἐὰν δὲ μὴ εἰσακούσητέ μου, μάχαιρα ὑμᾶς κατέδεται· τὸ γὰρ στόμα κυρίου ἐλάλησε ταῦτα“. Καὶ λόγον δὲ εἰς τοῦτο παρὰ τῶν ἀποστόλων ἐμάθομεν τοῦτον. Ἐπειδὴ τὴν πρώτην γένεσιν ἡμῶν ἀγνοοῦντες κατ᾿ ἀνάγκην γεγεννήμεθα ἐξ ὑγρᾶς σπορᾶς κατὰ μῖξιν τὴν τῶν γονέων πρὸς ἀλλήλους καὶ ἐν ἔθεσι φαύλοις καὶ πονηραῖς ἀναστροφαῖς γεγόναμεν, ὅπως μὴ ἀνάγκης τέκνα μηδὲ ἀγνοίας μένωμεν ἀλλὰ προαιρέσεως καὶ ἐπιστήμης, ἀφέσεώς ἁμαρτιῶν ὧν προημάρτομεν τύχωμεν, ἐν τῷ ὕδατι ἐπονομάζεται τῷ ἑλομένῳ ἀναγεννηθῆναι καὶ μετανοήσαντι ἐπὶ τοῖς ἡμαρτημένοις τὸ τοῦ πατρὸς τῶν ὅλων καὶ δεσπότου θεοῦ ὄνομα, αὐτὸ τοῦτο μόνον ἐπιλέγοντος τοῦ τὸν λουσόμενον ἄγοντος ἐπὶ τὸ λουτρόν. Ὄνομα γὰρ τῷ ἀῤῥήτῳ θεῷ οὐδεὶς ἔχει εἰπεῖν· εἰ δέ τις τολμήσειεν εἶναι λέγειν, μέμηνε τὴν ἄσωτον μανίαν. Καλεῖται δὲ τοῦτο τὸ λουτρὸν φωτισμός, ὡς φωτιζομένων τὴν διάνοιαν τῶν ταῦτα μανθανόντων. Καὶ ἐπ᾿ ὀνόματος δὲ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, τοῦ σταυρωθέντος ἐπὶ Ποντίου Πιλάτου, καὶ ἐπ᾿ ὀνόματος πνεύματος ἁγίου, ὃ διὰ τῶν προφητῶν προεκήρυξε τὰ κατὰ τὸν Ἰησοῦν πάντα, ὁ φωτιζόμενος λούεται.
pass_a_gloss: But in what manner we have dedicated ourselves to God, being renewed through Christ, we will explain, so that, having not passed over this, we may seem to be doing nothing evil in the explanation. As many as will be persuaded and will believe these things, which are taught and said by us, to be true, and will promise to be able to live in this manner, are taught, while fasting, to pray and to ask from God forgiveness of the things which they have previously sinned, with us praying and fasting together with them. Then they are led by us to where there is water, and in the manner of rebirth, which also we ourselves were reborn, they are reborn; for in the name of the Father of all and the Master God and of our Savior Jesus Christ and of the Holy Spirit, they then make the washing in the water. And also Christ said: 'If you are not reborn, you will not enter into the kingdom of heaven.' That it is also impossible for those who have been born once to enter into the wombs of those who have given birth is clear to all. And through Isaiah the prophet, as we have written before, it has been said, in what manner those who have sinned and are repenting will flee from sins. It has been said thus: 'Be washed, become clean, remove the evil deeds from your souls, learn to do good, judge the orphan and justify the widow, and come and let us reason together,' says the Lord; 'and if your sins are like scarlet, I will whiten them like snow, and if they are like crimson, I will whiten them like wool.' But if you do not listen to me, a sword will devour you; for the mouth of the Lord has spoken these things. And we have also learned this word from the apostles for this purpose. Since, not knowing our first birth, we were necessarily born from moist seed, according to the mixture of our parents with each other, and we became in evil and wicked habits, so that we may not remain children of necessity or of ignorance, but of choice and knowledge, and so that we may obtain forgiveness of the sins which we previously committed, in the water the name of the Father of all and the Master God is invoked over the one who chooses to be reborn and to repent over the things which he has sinned, the one who leads the one being washed to the washing invoking only this name. For no one has the name to say to the unutterable God; but if someone should dare to say it, he has a reckless madness. This washing is also called illumination, as the mind of those who learn these things is illuminated. And also in the name of Jesus Christ, who was crucified under Pontius Pilate, and in the name of the Holy Spirit, who through the prophets proclaimed beforehand all the things concerning Jesus, the one being illuminated is washed.

pass_b_english: We will explain how we have dedicated ourselves to God, having been renewed through Christ, so that by not passing this over we may not seem to be doing anything evil in the explanation. As many as are persuaded and believe that the things taught and said by us are true, and promise that they are able to live in this manner, are taught, while fasting, to pray and to ask from God forgiveness of the sins they have previously committed, with us praying and fasting together with them. Then they are led by us to where there is water, and in the manner of rebirth, by which we ourselves were also reborn, they are reborn; for in the name of the Father of all and Master God and of our Savior Jesus Christ and of the Holy Spirit, they then make the washing in the water. For Christ also said, 'Unless you are born again, you will by no means enter the kingdom of heaven' (John 3:3). That it is also impossible for those who have been born once to enter into the wombs of those who gave them birth is clear to all. And through Isaiah the prophet, as we have written before, it has been said, in what manner those who have sinned and are repenting will flee from sins. It has been said thus: 'Wash yourselves, become clean, remove the evil deeds from your souls, learn to do good, judge the orphan and justify the widow, and come and let us reason together,' says the Lord; 'and if your sins are like scarlet, I will whiten them like snow, and if they are like crimson, I will whiten them like wool. But if you do not listen to me, a sword will devour you; for the mouth of the Lord has spoken these things' (Isaiah 1:16-20). We have also learned this word from the apostles for this purpose. Since, not knowing our first birth, we were necessarily born from moist seed, according to the mixture of our parents with each other, and we became established in evil and wicked habits, so that we may not remain children of necessity or of ignorance, but of choice and knowledge, and so that we may obtain forgiveness of the sins which we previously committed, in the water the name of the Father of all and Master God is invoked over the one who chooses to be reborn and to repent over the things which he has sinned, the one who leads the one being washed to the washing invoking only this name. For no one has the name to say to the unutterable God; but if someone should dare to say it, he has a reckless madness. This washing is also called illumination, as the mind of those who learn these things is illuminated. And also in the name of Jesus Christ, who was crucified under Pontius Pilate, and in the name of the Holy Spirit, who through the prophets proclaimed beforehand all the things concerning Jesus, the one being illuminated is washed.
